column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set, not derived from a delta. Guards the engine half of cleat#1429: a workflow parked by DurableSleep is claimable by a DIFFERENT worker once next_wake_at passes, with the generation moving so the original worker fence is dead. Its control parks a second row an hour in the FUTURE and asserts that one is NOT claimable, without which the test would be measuring that ClaimWorkflow returns something rather than the next_wake_at predicate.
